lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 to 12 distinct vertical white lines are visible across the dark grey torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the midsection, with slightly tighter clustering observed in the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several lines in the posterior quarter terminate mid-flank before reaching the ventral fringe, specifically the lines closest to the hindquarters.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct white spots are visible on the upper haunch. A large, high-contrast white vertical patch is located on the posterior edge of the upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two white spots on the upper haunch align along a roughly horizontal axis.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a spiral lyrate growth pattern, curving outward from the frontal bone before twisting upward and inward at the terminals.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 3.8 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 10-15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white chevron between the eyes, two distinct white spots on the lower cheek/muzzle area, and high-contrast orange-tan 'stockings' on the lower extremities.
